verdict.rationale: Datalab's processing outputs come back in open formats (Markdown, HTML, JSON, chunks) through the API, SDK and CLI. Its core models (Marker, Chandra, Surya) are free open source, which lowers lock-in if you leave the hosted service. However, nothing documents exporting the data you hold on the platform itself, such as stored files, versioned pipelines or extraction schemas. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-wide export of stored files, pipeline configurations and schemas; an offboarding or data-deletion path; independent confirmation that a full exit works.
